method_note: Counted the 51 titled oral technical sessions of ECSSMET 2026 (Braunschweig, 21-25 Sep 2026) in the official Final Programme, with 171 talks. The poster session (8 posters), the four workshops (Load Derivation, Acoustic Testing and DFAN, Thermo-elastic Design, Digitalisation), plenaries and exhibitions were excluded. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. Structures/materials/dynamics/manufacturing sessions map to structures. Mechanical environmental-test sessions (acoustic incl. DFAT = direct field acoustic testing, shock, shaker/vibration, static load, test prediction, design & verification) are split 0.5 structures / 0.5 space-systems (AIT/verification). Thermal testing maps to space-systems. 'Deployable structures' maps to deployable-structures. 'Mechanism Testing' is split 0.5 mechanisms / 0.5 deployable-structures, because 5 of its 9 talks concern deployment (landing-gear deployment, deployable reflector, tape-spring hinges, large solar-array deployment). 'In flight experiments' is split 0.5 space-systems / 0.5 deployable-structures (2 of 3 talks are boom/mast deployment). Demise and Sustainable Spacecraft Structures are split 0.5 ssa-debris / 0.5 structures, and micro-vibration 0.5 structures / 0.5 spacecraft-gnc (line-of-sight stability). Four further deployable talks sit in non-deployable sessions (large deployable reflector qualification and analysis, deployable telescopic baffle, torque margins for deployables), so deployable-structures is somewhat under-counted. Keywords below 0.02 (spacecraft-gnc, ssa-debris; together 0.04 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
